instruction: Apply the approval policy to this quote request and return the required decision.
request_text:
Subject: Quote approval request — lead 5010

Hi Compliance team,

Could you run our quote approval policy on the request below and let me know the decision?

The lead (ID 5010) is currently marked "qualified" in the CRM. The customer is in the EMEA region, is a new (non-existing) customer, sits in the Commercial segment, has no overdue invoices on file, and is not on any credit hold. The deal is for $60,000 over a 12-month term, with a requested base discount of 28%.

Thanks,
Sales Operations
rationale_hint: Gates pass; B1 (EMEA) adds 5 %; effective 33 % > 30 %. P1 (over-limit cap) fires → DECLINE. Note that the base discount alone (28 %) would have been ESCALATE_VP.
